rows.evidence: The block has three parts. Two still hold and one has partly gone. (1) Design question 3 (S08) is still unanswered: snagging/discussion.md:105 lists the commodity search as blocked. (2) MDM has partly gone. EUDPA-617 merged to animals-frontend main on 27 Oct (c3183a8e). The live-animals search now calls reference-data /commodities (services/commodities/client.js:6-7 on origin/main, through search.js:13), ten results a page, labelled by Latin name. The germinal catalogue still waits on MDM: there is no germinal set on main (src/server/app/sets/ holds only live-animals), and inc-191 is still blocked. (3) The EUDPA-616 type-ahead is not on main. Its branch origin/feat/EUDPA-616-commodity-search-type-ahead (be139883, fab51dd1) is unmerged and stale against main: it edits search/matching.js, which EUDPA-617 deleted. That branch adds appLiveSearch (src/server/common/components/live-search/macro.njk), a server-rendered results fragment (_results.njk), an icon submit button, and a polite status saying 'N results available' with Welsh. It has no Escape handling, no 'Commodity search results' label and no 'options selected' announcement. Main's commodity page still has the plain input and the grey secondary Search button (commodities/search/search.njk:28-43 on origin/main), so criterion 10 is not met. Nothing on main meets any criterion.
rows.proposedChange: Keep the row blocked. Notes to add: (a) EUDPA-617 merged on 27 Oct, so the live-animals half of the MDM block has gone. The germinal half still waits on inc-191. Its appLiveSearch macro carries its own icon button, which duplicates main's appSubmittedSearch. Settle on one macro before criterion 10 is built.
